purpose: OpenGameAgent P2 realtime backpressure and same-channel recovery acceptance workload only; not a product or runtime default

evidence.actorCount: host-required acceptance input: exactly eight independent voice channels are exercised in every wave; not a runtime concurrency default
evidence.cyclesPerActor: host-required acceptance input: exactly thirty-two failure-and-recovery cycles are exercised per channel; not a runtime turn-count default
evidence.maxActiveActors: derived as actorCount because every wave starts one turn on each independent actor and intentionally requires no waiting actor lane
evidence.maxQueuedRuns: derived as actorCount because each serial wave synchronously starts exactly one turn per actor before runtime activation drains admission; no later wave overlaps it
evidence.eventBacklogCapacity: host-required acceptance input: the stalled public-event consumer admits exactly thirty-two events before the next event fails closed; not a product backlog default
evidence.textBacklogCapacity: host-required acceptance input: the stalled TTS consumer admits exactly thirty-two text segments before the next segment fails closed; not a product backlog default
evidence.textEventBacklogCapacity: derived as textBacklogCapacity plus the exact four non-audio public events in a failed text-backpressure turn; this also exceeds the exact six-event recovery turn
evidence.maxTotalTurns: derived as actorCount multiplied by cyclesPerActor multiplied by the exact four turns in each event-failure/event-recovery/text-failure/text-recovery cycle
evidence.maxSyntheticSegmentsPerWave: derived as actorCount multiplied by the larger of eventBacklogCapacity and textBacklogCapacity plus the one rejected boundary segment; it is the explicit provider-allocation budget per wave
evidence.progressTimeoutMs: reference-derived from the locked Vitest 4.1.11 non-browser per-test default; the deadline resets on every settled turn or collected stream and is not a runtime timeout default
